Evelyn Park: Noticed weirdness in the March invoice batch: several accounts have a negative reserved adjustment but no metered compute lines attached. Example INV-19577 for BlueHarbor shows -$950 but no GPU lines.
Jonah Ruiz: Which accounts? Any enterprise ones?
Evelyn Park: BlueHarbor, MosaicData, OneLift — total 3 accounts. Batch run id 100999 had proration errors in the logs.
Jonah Ruiz: I inspected job 100999: proration worker raised a 'line_merge_race' during aggregation. Retry path created duplicate Stripe invoice.create events for two customers.
billing-bot: billing-job 100999 status: ERROR proration: line_merge_race for 3 accounts. logs: https://logs.internal/billing/100999
Asha Patel: Can we patch and reissue? Customers are seeing unexpected refunds showing up.
Jonah Ruiz: Proposed fix: hotfix to add invoice create de-dupe by external_reference + 5s window and repair orphaned line items during the reissue. I estimate deploy + re-run ~90 minutes. Need finance approval to void/reissue affected invoices.
Evelyn Park: Please hold payouts for those accounts and prepare a short customer note template.
Asha Patel: Approved to void and reissue for these 3 accounts. Ensure we keep billing period identical and attach audit CSV.
Jonah Ruiz: Running fix now. Query to find orphaned meter lines I used: SELECT id, account_id FROM line_items WHERE invoice_id IS NULL AND period = '2025-03';
Jonah Ruiz: Re-run finished: 3 corrected invoices created, 2 duplicates voided, orphaned meter lines reattached. Net delta after rounding: +$40. Manual audit CSV attached to ticket.
Evelyn Park: Thanks — I'll update support tickets and monitor any customer replies. Asha, please schedule a short RCA for #postmortems.
Asha Patel: Will do. Closing thread once postmortem posted. (1795550060)
